experiment: DCEC Journal Extension - CLIP ViT-L/14 Multi-Backbone Validation
purpose: Test whether DCEC A3 generalizes to a larger CLIP backbone with a different embedding dimensionality.

method.architecture_policy: Preserve the DCEC A3 topology and quality-conditioning mechanism while adapting embedding-dependent linear dimensions from 512 to 768.

guardrails: Do not modify ViT-B/32 or ViT-B/16 checkpoints, code, or results.
Do not use the previously opened Flickr30K final test for tuning or iterative development.
If batch size must be reduced solely because of GPU memory limits, document the change before interpreting results.
Do not claim universal backbone-agnostic generality from this experiment alone.
